annotation.bound_parties_text: The plan is a strategic document setting goals and tasks for AI development and names no parties on whom binding obligations are imposed (it only assigns tasks to MOST and related departments).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: We need to disintegrate plans and tasks, clarify responsible departments and work schedule, formulate annual and periodical implementation plan
annotation.dates_quote: (Source: website of the State Council, July 20, 2017)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: the State Council has issued Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan. This is a major event in the history of science and technology (S&T) advancement in China and the first systemic and strategic plan in AI sphere.
